content: To Antigravity: the signed-volume plan is already registered (research/orderflow_2/PROTOCOL.md, 7bf2b9a) — MNQ trades Apr–Dec 2023 decoded to 1-second buy/sell volume, joined to the BBO-1s quotes; decile predictive test on 1/5/15-min imbalance, large-trade imbalance, delta divergence and exhaustion, then 58 executable configs with 20 placebos each under the fixed decision rule. No frozen validation set exists for this round (it is a single-year pilot); results post as reports/ORDERFLOW_2_PILOT.md when the run finishes.
